children.text: Conversation 1: Meeting at the Park
children.cn: 对话1：公园相遇

children.text: Greetings & Introducing Classmate
children.cn: 打招呼与介绍同学

children.text: Morning, Emma.
children.speaker: Yaming
children.cn: 早安，埃玛。
children.notes: Morning = Good morning 的简略表达
children.statement: Morning 是非正式的问候语。
children.explanation: 口语中常直接说 Morning 来表示问候。

children.text: Oh, hi, Yaming! Glad to see you here in the park!
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 哦，你好，亚明！很高兴在公园里见到你！
children.notes: Glad to see you = 很高兴见到你
children.statement: Glad to see you 表示见到对方很开心。
children.explanation: Glad 表示高兴的，欣慰的。

children.text: Me too. Emma, these are my parents. Dad and Mum, this is my classmate, Emma.
children.speaker: Yaming
children.cn: 我也是。埃玛，这是我的父母。爸爸妈妈，这是我的同学埃玛。
children.notes: these are 用于介绍多人；this is 用于介绍单人
children.statement: 介绍单个人时应该用 these are。
children.explanation: 介绍单个人用 this is，介绍多人用 these are。

children.text: Meeting the Parents and Sister
children.cn: 问候父母与认识妹妹

children.text: Nice to meet you, Emma.
children.speaker: Mr & Mrs Wang
children.cn: 很高兴见到你，埃玛。
children.notes: 初次见面的常用客套话
children.statement: Nice to meet you 是初次见面时的常用语。
children.explanation: Nice to meet you 用于初次见面问好。

children.text: Nice to meet you too, Mr and Mrs Wang.
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 我也很高兴见到你们，王先生、王太太。
children.notes: too 表示“也”
children.statement: 句末的 too 表示“同样，也”。
children.explanation: too 放在句末常表示“也”。

children.text: And this is my sister, Yaqi.
children.speaker: Yaming
children.cn: 这是我的妹妹，亚琪。
children.notes: this is... 用于介绍他人
children.statement: 句中的 sister 只能指姐姐。
children.explanation: sister 可以指姐姐或妹妹。

children.text: Hi, Yaqi!
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 嗨，亚琪！
children.notes: 问候语
children.statement: Hi 是非正式问候语。
children.explanation: Hi 用于打招呼。

children.text: Hi, Emma!
children.speaker: Yaqi
children.cn: 嗨，埃玛！
children.notes: 问候语
children.statement: 这是回答问候的表达。
children.explanation: 用 Hi 回应 Hi。

children.text: Conversation 2: Looking at Family Photos
children.cn: 对话2：看家庭照片

children.text: Identifying Parents, Uncle, and Aunt
children.cn: 确认父母与叔婶

children.text: Is this your family photo, Peter?
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 这是你的全家福吗，彼得？
children.notes: family photo = 全家福/家庭照片
children.statement: family photo 意为“家庭照片”。
children.explanation: family 家族，photo 照片。

children.text: Yes, it is.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 是的，它是。
children.notes: 一般疑问句的简略回答
children.statement: 回答 Is this...? 用 Yes, it is.
children.explanation: 单数指示代词提问用 it 作答。

children.text: Are these your parents?
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 这些是你的父母吗？
children.notes: Are these... 复数疑问句型
children.statement: these 指代复数概念，对应动词 are。
children.explanation: these 是复数，系动词用 are。

children.text: Yes, they are.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 是的，他们是。
children.notes: they 指代 these
children.statement: 复数指示代词提问用 they 回答。
children.explanation: they 代替 these 回答。

children.text: Who's he?
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 他是谁？
children.notes: Who's = Who is
children.statement: Who's 是 Who is 的缩写。
children.explanation: Who's 缩写自 Who is。

children.text: He's my father's brother, my uncle. And this is my aunt.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 他是我爸爸的兄弟，我的叔叔。而这是我的阿姨/婶婶。
children.notes: father's 名词所有格；uncle 叔叔/伯伯
children.statement: father's 表示“爸爸的”。
children.explanation: 名词后加 's 表示所有格。

children.text: Identifying Sister, Cousin, and Grandparents
children.cn: 确认姐妹、堂兄弟与祖父母

children.text: Who's she?
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 她是谁？
children.notes: 询问女性身份
children.statement: she 用来指代女性。
children.explanation: she 是人称代词“她”。

children.text: She's my sister, Helen.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 她是我的姐姐/妹妹海伦。
children.notes: She's = She is
children.statement: She's 是 She has 的缩写。
children.explanation: 此处 She's 是 She is 的缩写。

children.text: Is this your brother?
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 这是你的兄弟吗？
children.notes: brother 兄弟
children.statement: 这是询问单人身份的疑问句。
children.explanation: Is this 用于询问这是某人吗。

children.text: No, it's my cousin, David. This is my brother, Jim.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 不，他是我的堂弟大卫。这是我的弟弟吉姆。
children.notes: cousin 堂/表兄弟姐妹
children.statement: cousin 表示堂兄弟姐妹或表兄弟姐妹。
children.explanation: cousin 是同辈旁系亲属的统称。

children.text: Who are they?
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 他们是谁？
children.notes: 询问多人身份
children.statement: 询问多人用 Who is...。
children.explanation: 询问多人用 Who are...。

children.text: They're my grandparents. They're my father's parents.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 他们是我的祖父母。他们是我父亲的父母。
children.notes: grandparents 祖父母/外祖父母
children.statement: grandparents 指爷爷奶奶或外公外婆。
children.explanation: grandparents 是祖父母的双数形式。

children.text: What a happy family!
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 多幸福的一家人啊！
children.notes: What a... 感叹句
children.statement: 这句话是一个感叹句。
children.explanation: What a + 形容词 + 名词 构成感叹句。

children.text: Welcome and Ping-pong Bats
children.cn: 欢迎进门与乒乓球拍

children.text: Hi, Peter! Come in.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 嗨，彼得！快请进。
children.notes: Come in = 请进
children.statement: Come in 意思是“请进”。
children.explanation: Come in 是客套邀请进门的话。

children.text: Thanks. Oh, these ping-pong bats are nice. Whose are they?
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 谢谢。哦，这些乒乓球拍真好。它们是谁的？
children.notes: Whose 是疑问代词，询问“谁的”
children.statement: Whose 用来询问物品的主人。
children.explanation: Whose 表示“谁的”。

children.text: Well, this is my ping-pong bat, and the old one is my grandpa's.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 嗯，这是我的乒乓球拍，那个旧的是我爷爷的。
children.notes: one 代替前面提到的 bat
children.statement: 句中的 one 指代的是 ping-pong bat。
children.explanation: one 代替上文出现过的单数可数名词。

children.text: Do you often play ping-pong together?
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 你们经常一起打乒乓球吗？
children.notes: play ping-pong 打乒乓球；together 一起
children.statement: together 意思是“独自一人”。
children.explanation: together 意思是“一起，共同”。

children.text: Yes, we play every week. My grandpa loves sport.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 是的，我们每周都打。我爷爷非常喜欢运动。
children.notes: every week 每周；loves 动词三单
children.statement: 主语是 My grandpa，动词要用单三形式 loves。
children.explanation: 第三人称单数主语，一般现在时动词加 -s。

children.text: Fishing Rods and Mother's Piano
children.cn: 钓鱼竿与妈妈的钢琴

children.text: Whose fishing rods are those?
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 那些是谁的钓鱼竿？
children.notes: fishing rods 钓鱼竿
children.statement: those 指代较近的物品。
children.explanation: those 指代距离较远的多件物品。

children.text: They're my father's. He spends a lot of time fishing.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 它们是我爸爸的。他花很多时间钓鱼。
children.notes: spend time doing sth 花时间做某事
children.statement: spend 后面接动词要用 -ing 形式（fishing）。
children.explanation: spend time in doing sth，介词 in 常省略。

children.text: Hey, do you play the piano?
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 嘿，你会弹钢琴吗？
children.notes: play the piano 弹钢琴，乐器前加 the
children.statement: 演奏西洋乐器名称前通常要加定冠词 the。
children.explanation: play the piano / violin 等都需要加 the。

children.text: No, I don't. It's my mother's piano. She can play it really well!
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 不，我不会。是我妈妈的钢琴。她弹得非常好！
children.notes: can 情态动词后接动词原形；really well 非常好
children.statement: well 在这里是副词，修饰动词 play。
children.explanation: well 修饰动词 play，意为“好”。

children.text: Introduction and Dad & Brother
children.cn: 自我介绍与爸爸弟弟

children.text: Hi, I'm Lily from Ireland. I love my big family. Here's a photo of us. I'm the one with the pink hat.
children.cn: 嗨，我是来自爱尔兰的莉莉。我爱我的大家庭。这是我们的一张照片。我是戴粉红色帽子的那个人。
children.notes: from 来自；with 戴着/穿着
children.statement: with the pink hat 作后置定语修饰 the one。
children.explanation: with 介词短语修饰前面的人，表示特征。
children.keywords: lily, ireland, big family, photo, pink hat

children.text: This is my dad, Fred, on the left. He's very handsome. He often plays tennis with me.
children.cn: 这是我爸爸弗雷德，在左边。他非常英俊。他经常和我一起打网球。
children.notes: on the left 在左边；handsome 英俊的
children.statement: handsome 通常用来形容女性漂亮。
children.explanation: handsome 主要用于形容男性英俊、帅气。
children.keywords: dad, fred, left, handsome, plays tennis

children.text: My little brother, Sam, is on his knee. Sam is seven, and he really likes chess.
children.cn: 我的小弟弟萨姆坐在他的膝盖上。萨姆七岁了，他真的很喜欢下棋。
children.notes: on his knee 在他膝盖上；likes chess 喜欢国际象棋
children.statement: he 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词加 -s 变成 likes。
children.explanation: 第三人称单数主语，动词加 -s。

children.text: Mum, Grandparents, and Grandchildren
children.cn: 妈妈、祖父母与孙辈

children.text: My mum, Jane, is on the right. She's beautiful and kind. She always reads me a story at night.
children.cn: 我的妈妈珍在右边。她很漂亮也很善良。她总是在晚上给我讲故事。
children.notes: on the right 在右边；at night 在晚上
children.statement: reads me a story 意思是“给我读故事”。
children.explanation: read sb a story 意为给某人读故事。
children.keywords: mum, jane, right, beautiful, kind, reads, story, night

children.text: My grandparents, Jack and Sarah, are in the middle. They're my dad's parents. They have a dog. His name is Oscar.
children.cn: 我的祖父母杰克和莎拉在中间。他们是我爸爸的父母。他们有一只狗。它的名字叫奥斯卡。
children.notes: in the middle 在中间
children.statement: in the middle 意思是“在边缘”。
children.explanation: in the middle 意思是“在中间”。
children.keywords: grandparents, middle, dad's parents, dog, oscar

children.text: My grandparents have three grandchildren: Sam, my cousin Lucy, and me.
children.cn: 我的祖父母有三个孙辈：萨姆，我的堂妹露西，还有我。
children.notes: grandchildren 孙子/孙女/外孙/外孙女（复数）
children.statement: grandchildren 是 grandchild 的复数形式。
children.explanation: grandchild 的复数是不规则变化 grandchildren。
children.keywords: grandparents, three grandchildren, sam, cousin lucy

children.text: They often say I'm their favourite grandchild, but I think they say the same thing to all of us!
children.cn: 他们经常说我是他们最喜欢的孙孩子，但我认为他们对我们所有人都是这么说的！
children.notes: favourite 最喜欢的；the same 相同的
children.statement: favourite 表示“最喜欢的”。
children.explanation: favourite 意为最喜爱的。
children.keywords: favourite, grandchild, same thing, all of us

children.text: English Name Structure & Naming after Elders
children.cn: 英文名结构与长辈尊称

children.text: Hello! My name is Alan, and I'm from the UK. Here most people have a first, middle, and last name.
children.cn: 你好！我的名字叫阿兰，我来自英国。在这里大多数人有名字、中间名和姓氏。
children.notes: first name 名字；middle name 中间名；last name 姓氏
children.statement: first name 意思是“姓氏”。
children.explanation: first name 是“名字”，last name 才是“姓氏”。
children.keywords: alan, uk, first name, middle name, last name

children.text: My full name is Alan Luke Wood. Alan is my first name, Luke is my middle name, and Wood is my last name.
children.cn: 我的全名是阿兰·卢克·伍德。阿兰是我的名字，卢克是我的中间名，伍德是我的姓氏。
children.notes: full name 全名
children.statement: Wood 是 Alan 的名字。
children.explanation: Wood 是他的姓氏（last name）。
children.keywords: full name, alan, luke, wood, last name

children.text: We also call the last name a "family name" or "surname".
children.cn: 我们也将姓氏称为“家族名”或“姓”。
children.notes: family name / surname 都表示“姓氏”
children.statement: surname 和 last name 同义。
children.explanation: surname 和 last name、family name 都指姓氏。

children.text: My grandfather also has three names. His full name is George Charles Wood.
children.cn: 我的祖父也有三个名字。他的全名是乔治·查尔斯·伍德。
children.notes: also 相当于“也”
children.statement: Alan 的祖父也有三个名字。
children.explanation: 文中明说 His full name is George Charles Wood。
children.keywords: grandfather, three names, george charles wood

children.text: My father's name is the same as my grandfather's. Can you guess why? It shows great respect to my grandfather.
children.cn: 我父亲的名字和我祖父的一样。你能猜出为什么吗？这表达了我对祖父的极大尊重。
children.notes: the same as 与……一样；respect 尊重
children.statement: the same as 表示“与……不同”。
children.explanation: the same as 意思是“与……相同”。

children.text: People call my father George Charles Wood Junior, and they call my grandfather George Charles Wood Senior.
children.cn: 人们称呼我父亲为小乔治·查尔斯·伍德，称呼我祖父为老乔治·查尔斯·伍德。
children.notes: Junior 小（用于同名父子中的儿子）；Senior 老（用于同名父子中的父亲）
children.statement: Junior 用于称呼长辈，Senior 用于称呼晚辈。
children.explanation: Junior 表示小，用于晚辈；Senior 表示老，用于长辈。

children.text: Marriage Name Changes & Family Connections
children.cn: 婚后姓氏变更与家庭纽带

children.text: My mother's name was Linda Grant, but now her name is Linda Wood. Why is that?
children.cn: 我母亲以前的名字叫琳达·格兰特，但现在她的名字叫琳达·伍德。为什么会这样呢？
children.notes: was 过去式，表示以前是
children.statement: Linda Grant 是她现在的名字。
children.explanation: 以前是 Linda Grant，现在改为 Linda Wood。

children.text: Because in the UK, a woman often changes her family name to her husband's family name.
children.cn: 因为在英国，妇女经常把自己的姓氏改为丈夫的姓氏。
children.notes: because 因为；change... to... 把……改为……
children.statement: Because 用来引导原因状语从句。
children.explanation: Because 表示原因。
children.keywords: because, uk, woman, changes, family name, husband

children.text: Sometimes, however, the woman's last name and the man's last name are joined together.
children.cn: 然而，有时女方的姓氏和男方的姓氏会连在一起。
children.notes: however 然而；joined together 结合在一起
children.statement: however 表示转折关系。
children.explanation: however 是副词，意为“然而”。
children.keywords: sometimes, however, woman's, man's, joined together

children.text: This allows both family names to live on.
children.cn: 这使得两个家族的姓氏都能延续下去。
children.notes: allow sb/sth to do 允许……做……；live on 延续，生存
children.statement: live on 在这里意思是“延续，留存”。
children.explanation: live on 表达姓氏或文化等得以保留和延续。
children.keywords: allows, both, family names, live on

children.text: Names show family ties. What do you think?
children.cn: 名字展现了家庭的纽带。你认为呢？
children.notes: family ties 家庭纽带/亲情关联
children.statement: ties 在这里指的是“纽带，联系”。
children.explanation: family ties 即“家庭纽带/关系”。
